evidence: Adds C API endpoints and C++ wrappers in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, tested in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
rationale: The PR adds a major capability to libbitcoinkernel by enabling block validation against caller-supplied UTXOs without requiring an on-disk chainstate database. Expanding the library API to support block verification directly advances API completeness for external consumers.
